lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Clusters of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the branchial slits. Primary centroids mid-flank exhibit greater spacing than those near the dorsal margin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light upper edges to shadowed lower basins.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes of commensal Echeneidae are visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface and branchial region.
